pulls.activity: 新建、2 个 Review、6 条评论
pulls.body_excerpt: Hi, This code tries to compute the `join` of a widen type with `in_type`, but it does so manually, so it misses unsigned bounds and known bits. This leads to a peculiar case when the node created by `Ideal` has a wider type, but then `Value` narrows the type back to the original value. So, even if the node does not change, we notify its users and inputs about the change. This notification can result in the node being pushed onto the worklist again, leading to an infinite loop. pulls.author: zifeihan
pulls.body_excerpt: Hi, please consider. MacroAssembler::set_narrow_klass uses li32 (lui + addiw) to materialize a narrow klass constant into a register. Since addiw sign-extends the 32-bit result to 64 bits, the function previously emitted a zext.w unconditionally to clear the upper 32 bits. However, sign extension only corrupts the upper bits when bit 31 of the narrow klass value is set (i.e., (int32_t)nk < 0). pulls.title: 8386936: Shenandoah: Treat Abbreviated GC cycles specially
pulls.author: kdnilsen
pulls.body_excerpt: Abbreviated cycles run in much less time than normal cycles because they skip the evacuation and update phases of operation. In general, we cannot anticipate that a triggered GC cycle will be abbreviated until after we have completed marking, though some workloads have higher likelihood of abbreviated cycles than others. If abbreviated cycles are "averaged in" to the GC-time prediction model, this can cause us to underestimate how much time is required to perform a future GC cycle, causing us to trigger late. pulls.author: XiaohongGong
pulls.body_excerpt: This is a follow-up patch of [1], which aims at implementing the subword gather load APIs for AArch64 SVE platform. ### Background Vector gather load APIs load values from memory addresses calculated by adding a base pointer to integer indices. SVE provides native gather load instructions for `byte`/`short` types using `int` vectors for indices. The vector size for a gather-load instruction is determined by the index vector (i.e. `int` elements). Hence, the total size is `32 * elem_num` bits, where `elem_num` is the number of loaded elements in the vector register. ### Implementation #### Chal
